historicalDrawingSources.title: Newes Modelbuch in Kupffer
historicalDrawingSources.creator: Johann Sibmacher
historicalDrawingSources.review: Two selected additional images viewed: index 10, text with ornamental border; index 30, counted floral/geometric pattern bands. Not a complete book review.
historicalDrawingSources.finding: Explicit counted-cell drawings provide boundaries, repeated band units, nested geometric figures and a distinction between shape and pattern filling.

rights.assessment: Current official Met API isPublicDomain=true; Met Open Access CC0 policy

historicalDrawingSources.title: Plate 37 from Schon News Modelbuch
historicalDrawingSources.finding: Different repeats fit three shaped panels; large units, smaller intervening units, border ornaments and a dense counted-grid alternative have distinct roles.

rights.assessment: Retained Archive.org record declares CC0; current official Cleveland API refresh returned HTTP403. No new fixture admission.

historicalDrawingSources.title: Embroidery Pattern with Round Medallion in its Center
historicalDrawingSources.creator: Albrecht Dürer
historicalDrawingSources.review: Full image visually examined and museum description read.
historicalDrawingSources.finding: Concentric knotwork tiers surround a central medallion, with separate corner ornaments. Over/under crossings are not ordinary attachment junctions.

rights.assessment: Current official Met API isPublicDomain=true; Met Open Access CC0 policy

historicalDrawingSources.title: Embroidery And Pattern Design: A Handbook for Teachers and Art Students
historicalDrawingSources.creator: Hannah Fowler; George F. Craggs
historicalDrawingSources.review: Selected OCR passages: printed pages 110, 118, 128 and 144–149. OCR can contain errors; selected illustration PDF request returned HTTP500, and those book illustrations were not visually verified.
historicalDrawingSources.finding: Mass before detail; radial growth from a point or line; layout borders before an interior network; proportion/spacing; tracing, pouncing and stencil transfer as separate stages.

rights.assessment: Research reading only; no worldwide reuse licence verified and no geometry admitted.

historicalDrawingSources.title: The Twentieth century pattern book for Norwegian lace and embroidery
historicalDrawingSources.review: OCR captions read and PDF page 12, bedspread pattern 16, visually examined. Not all pattern plates reviewed. Catalogue/printed editor spelling discrepancy retained.
historicalDrawingSources.finding: Different central and flanking band vocabularies combine counted units with open fabric structure.

rights.assessment: Research reading only; no fresh item-specific worldwide reuse assessment and no geometry admitted.

ukrainianScholarlySources.title: Embroidery on Ukrainian clothes: the problem of origins
ukrainianScholarlySources.review: Abstract, selected body passages about source evidence and ornamental origins, conclusions and bibliography read.
ukrainianScholarlySources.finding: Early origins and woven-versus-embroidered precedence are unresolved hypotheses; this paper does not certify the antiquity or symbolism of a selected motif.
